name: Flexão de pernas deslizante
directions: Sliding floor hamstring curl. Supine, HEAD/SHOULDERS and palms SUPPORTED on floor; heels on small towels/sliders. Hips lifted in bridge throughout. Start legs nearly straight, slide BOTH heels toward hips until knees90degrees, keeping shoulders down and hips up. No floating head or bench.
instructions: Deitado, calcanhares sobre toalha em piso liso.
Suba o quadril e puxe os calcanhares em direção ao corpo.
